fixtures.expected_behavior: buyJay (vendored L1111-L1150) reaches buyJayWithERC721 (L1152), whose loop body performs IERC721(_tokenAddress[id]).transferFrom on an attacker-supplied token address (L1157) BEFORE the state effects _mint (L1142) and nftsSold (L1147) and before the price-dependent emit Price (L1149). A malicious ERC-721 reenters sell (L1185) mid-buyJay and trades at JAYtoETH (L1227-L1229) = value*address(this).balance/totalSupply, which already reflects the caller's msg.value, so JAY is sold at an inflated price. This is the reported Jaypeggers exploit of 2022-12-29 (15.32 ETH): Hypernative (2023-01-10) and SolidityScan (2023) both independently name buyJay, the transferFrom on the attacker's fake ERC-721, and reentry via sell. The contract has no reentrancy guard, so Function.is_reentrant is true.
